design_philosophy.name: Swiss Utility
design_philosophy.description: A high-precision, content-first aesthetic that prioritizes clarity, whitespace, and typographic hierarchy. It merges the reliability of enterprise software with the sharpness of Swiss graphic design.
core_principles: Content is King: Data and text are the interface.
High Contrast: Black text on white/gray backgrounds. No low-contrast gray-on-gray.
Structural Borders: Use 1px crisp borders to define areas, rather than heavy shadows.
Feedback is Immediate: Every action has a clear, animated reaction.

layout.grid_system: Use 'container mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8' for main wrappers. Dashboard grid: 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6'.

strategies.dashboard: Bento Grid style. Key stats in large blocks, lists in tall blocks.
strategies.processing: Centralized, focused single-column view with max-width-2xl.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: `yarn add @fontsource/outfit @fontsource/inter @fontsource/jetbrains-mono lucide-react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge`.
Configure Tailwind: Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the new fonts and extend the color palette as defined.
Global Styles: Import the fonts in `index.css` or `App.js`.
Layout Strategy: Always start with a `Layout` component that includes a top navigation bar and a centered content container.
Navigation: The top bar should have the App Logo (Left) and a 'New Generation' button (Right) if not on the home page.
Theme: Strictly enforce Light Mode. Do not implement Dark Mode toggles as per user request.
Feedback: Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications.
Data-TestId: Add `data-testid` to every button, input, and card.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects only for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).
All forms must have client-side validation with visual error states (red border + text).
